title: Earnings Event Research
objective: Prepare a source-verified earnings brief and examine post-release reactions without implying predictable drift.
required_inputs: Option chain if options exposure is reviewed

steps.output: Verified event timestamp and source ledger
Earnings quality and reaction study design
Event brief with explicit human decision gates

decision_gates: Verify event date and release time from issuer or exchange sources.
Do not mix actual results with stale or incomparable consensus estimates.
Review overnight gap, implied volatility, and liquidity risk before any human decision.
